experiences.name: Nevis Bungy Jump
experiences.description: Leap from New Zealand's highest bungy platform at 134 meters above the Nevis River gorge. This iconic AJ Hackett experience offers a 8.5-second freefall with breathtaking views of the surrounding Remarkables mountain range. Includes transport from Queenstown and a commemorative certificate.

experiences.name: Routeburn Track Great Walk
experiences.description: Hike one of New Zealand's nine Great Walks, a stunning 32km trail through Fiordland and Mount Aspiring National Parks. Trek past alpine meadows, glacial lakes, and dramatic mountain passes with panoramic views. A multi-day hike or guided day section offers world-class scenery and diverse wildlife encounters.

experiences.name: Franz Josef Glacier Valley Walk
experiences.description: Explore the terminal face of the famous Franz Josef Glacier on a guided valley floor walk. Trek through ancient rainforest, over glacial outwash plains, and up to the ice face viewpoint. Learn about glacial geology and climate change impacts from expert local guides while surrounded by the dramatic Southern Alps.

experiences.name: Milford Sound Kayak and Hike Combo
experiences.description: Combine a guided sea kayaking session on the mirror-like waters of Milford Sound with a hike along the Milford foreshore track. Paddle beneath towering Mitre Peak, spot fur seals and dolphins, and explore hidden waterfalls. The hike portion winds through ancient podocarp rainforest with stunning fiord views.

experiences.name: Hangi Feast and Maori Cultural Experience
experiences.description: Immerse yourself in authentic Maori culture with a traditional hangi meal cooked underground using heated stones. Witness powerful haka performances, learn about Maori navigation and history, and participate in traditional games and weaving. A deeply enriching cultural evening that connects you with New Zealand's indigenous heritage.
experiences.location: Te Ana Maori Rock Art Centre, Timaru
